test_case.purpose: Run exact Llama99.9 only after one authoritative scenario and release-valid command define its compliance rules.
required_package: Exact Llama model/revision and MLPerf release/repository
Approved Server or Offline scenario and exact command/load profile
Supported AMD GPU/runtime/power profile and matched reference/delta
Health abort, invalid-run and cleanup policy
test_case.test_command: Do not run until scenario and command are approved. Then validate exact model/artifact hashes/licenses and GPU health; execute accuracy plus selected-scenario LoadGen stages; preserve validity/performance/telemetry and compare only to a same-scenario Llama99.9 reference.
test_case.expected_result: Exact Llama99.9 high-accuracy and selected-scenario validity pass, score meets approved delta and platform remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact model,99.9 config, explicit scenario/command, validity and threshold. Mixed or inferred scenario cannot pass.
safety_gate: Preserve all evidence; no official-submission claim.
test_case.recovery: If a supplied harness defaults to the wrong scenario or model revision, terminate before performance scoring, retain config/LoadGen diagnostics, restore GPU runtime/power state, and require the Llama99.9 owner to issue a corrected scenario-locked package before any rerun.
